verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client, and routing all device internet traffic through an exit node is a VPN/mesh-network capability outside that product type. The documented SSH local port forwarding (-L tunnels) only forwards individual ports, not all traffic, so it does not make the exit-node axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
